verdict.rationale: The only interactive reference in the evidence is the auto-generated component documentation in the `Docs` tab of the local `dg dev` webserver; the docs otherwise offer static code snippets. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, and nothing shows a try-it-out API explorer or examples that run from the reference. Missing for 10: an interactive API explorer, runnable or executable examples in the reference, an OpenAPI/Swagger spec, and independent corroboration.
